# Security Policy

We take security issues seriously.

If you discover a potential security vulnerability in Harken (HarkenStudio / Harken Hub / Unity Integration / engine runtime), please **report it privately**. Do not open a public Issue or disclose it through any public channel.

## How to Report

Email **harken-support@xd.com** with the subject **Security report**. Include sensitive details only in this private report, not in a public Issue or Pull Request.

Please include where possible:

- Affected version (build number);
- Steps to reproduce;
- Proof of concept (if available).

## Our Commitment

We will assess every report as quickly as we can and contact you if more information is needed. Please refrain from publicly disclosing vulnerability details until we have had reasonable time to investigate and fix the issue.
